title: Authorize the analysis progress report relocation
goal: Pre-authorize the exact move, TCB and policy tuples of the frozen CP11l report relocation candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: The move authorization binds the old and new report tuples with an identical blob.
The TCB authorization binds the affected manifest component paths.
The weaken-policy authorization binds the report registration and candidate content.
The authorization-only checkpoint changes no report or implementation.
The relocation candidate consumes all three authorizations exactly once.
